authority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only multiple-events-multiple-targets for one separately preregistered zero-new-row capacity screen against the eligible 4.7.2 explicit-Flare cache. Do not open the cache before its complete gates are frozen, inspect Beacon, implement a payoff, add a carrier, simulate, add a ledger row, use a method or protected seed.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains zero SHATTER events and therefore zero distinct Shatter targets.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: No Shatter topology exists; rewarding this cell would be an Attack, card-play or failure scalar.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains exactly one SHATTER event on one enemy idx.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: This is ordinary target-local Shatter. Its threshold, global payoff, Art buff and temporal fuel variants are bounded closed families.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains at least two SHATTER events but exactly one distinct enemy idx.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: Repeated same-enemy Shatter is the closed reseam topology; selecting hit multiplicity or a card subset would reopen frozen families.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains at least two SHATTER events on at least two distinct living-enemy idx values.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: This is a resolved card-scoped cross-enemy concurrency relation. It is not the closed pre-card partial-Facet ownership predicate, same-target repeat, global Art buff or hit-multiplicity scalar.

frontierScope.claimBoundary: This source-only audit may select at most one topology for a separately preregistered zero-new-row capacity screen. It cannot establish natural activation, candidate payoff, causal effect, complementarity, acquisition, package acceptance or product authority.
excluded: Art or potion Shatters outside a PLAY window
same-enemy Shatter threshold or reseam reward
hit count, damage, Ward, status or partial-Facet threshold
card, enemy, act or formation subset
payoff, carrier, acquisition or policy score
new persistent state, ML, RL or optimiser
frontierScope.included: The count of SHATTER events and distinct enemy idx values emitted while one played card resolves. The representation is Dusk-only by existing apply_chips law and adds no payoff, state, event, threshold or carrier.

selectedRepresentation.eventOrderSafety: The window begins at PLAY and ends at the played card's TO_DISCARD, EXHAUST or POWER_CONSUMED event. Art and turn-boundary Shatters are outside it.
selectedRepresentation.exactPredicate: Within one PLAY-to-card-terminal event window, SHATTER event count is at least two and the set of SHATTER idx values has size at least two.
selectedRepresentation.name: multi-enemy card Shatter
